description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

VTG is hiring a Web Developer to develop, test, and deploy web solutions for government websites and knowledge repositories. The role includes site administration, content workflows and quality assurance, portal design, and implementation of modern web technologies and user interfaces.
Web Developer administering government websites and knowledge repositories, building content workflows and JavaScript-based interfaces

Responsibilities:
• Perform administration and design of government web-pages and knowledge repositories across multiple classified and unclassified domains
• Manage site permissions, groups, user attributes, and pages/portals
• Develop and implement content management workflows, including task management, product review and approval, and posting activity
• Perform spot-checks and quality assurance of posted content
• Participate in website and portal design projects to maximize discoverability, readership, and access, within established government policies
• Research and implement modern web technologies to create innovative user interfaces and improve workflow efficiency
• Create visual concepts by using JavaScript and other browser-based technologies such as, React, Angular, jQuery, and Bootstrap
• Demonstrate visual expertise including gathering raw data from various sources and developing comprehensive and visually engaging designs
• Consult with customer to define the strategy needed to expand and enhance the website in both scope of content and technical features

Requirements:
• strong customer service and communication skills
• the ability to learn new concepts quickly
• Active TS/SCI w/poly
• Bachelor of Science degree in Information Systems, Computer Science or another applicable field with 0-3 years of experience. Relevant years of experience can be substituted in lieu of degree
• Client-side development experience using JavaScript frameworks/libraries and other relevant front-end web technologies
• Experience using InfoPath and SharePoint designer to develop workflows and data view web parts
• Experienced in enforcing site standards, including security policies, to ensure the governance policies and processes are maintained
• Ability to handle a fast-paced environment and to work collaboratively with personnel from multiple functions and at all levels of the customer organization to deliver results; strong networking, interpersonal, customer service skills, team building and problem solving skills with an ability to be effective in a government/contractor team environment

Preferred:
• Experience with other client-side technologies such as jQuery, CAML, XSLT, Rest API/ Web Services to be able to use the SharePoint client object model (CSOM) to query lists, manipulate list items and create on-demand reports and mashup of data to deliver content in an easy to understand manner
• Familiarity with MVC/MVVM frameworks such as AngularJS, React, and .NET MVC is a plus
• Experience with HTML, CSS, XSLT and Master Pages to deliver a user-friendly experience to the client
• Experience implementing solutions using SharePoint content types, lists, columns, web parts, features, page layouts, managed metadata keywords and other enterprise management features to provide collaboration solutions
• Experience developing PowerShell scripts
